name: Volibear
title: the Relentless Storm

Q.name: Thundering Smash
Q.description: Volibear gains 0.12/0.155/0.19/0.225/0.26 Move Speed, doubled to 0.24/0.31/0.38/0.45/0.52 towards enemy champions for the next 4 seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals 10/20/30/40/50 + 1×AD + 1.6×bonus AD physical damage and Stuns the target for 1 second. Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.
Q.summary: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

W.name: Frenzied Maul
W.description: Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing 5/30/55/80/105 + 1.1×AD + 0.06×bonus max HP physical damage and marking them for 8 seconds. If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to (5/30/55/80/105 + 1.1×AD + 0.06×bonus max HP) × (1.5 + 0.002×bonus AD) and Volibear restores 20/35/50/65/80 plus 0.08/0.11/0.14/0.17/0.2 missing Health.
W.summary: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.

E.name: Sky Splitter
E.description: Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 + 0.7×AP plus 11/12/13/14.0/15% max Health magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a 0.75×AP plus 14.0% max Health Shield for 3 seconds.
E.summary: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.

R.name: Stormbringer
R.description: Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining 175/350/525 Health and 50 Attack Range for the next 12 seconds. Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for 2/3/4 seconds and dealing 300/500/700 + 1.25×AP + 2.5×bonus AD physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by 50%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer 300/500/700 + 1.25×AP + 2.5×bonus AD physical damage.
R.summary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

Passive.name: The Relentless Storm
Passive.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
Passive.summary: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Volibear is a bruiser who charges in with Thundering Smash and mauls enemies with Frenzied Maul. He plays top or jungle, wins early duels and dives towers with Stormbringer.
strengths: Thundering Smash gives a stun and speed to engage or chase.
Frenzied Maul heals him on a marked target, so he wins trades.
Stormbringer disables towers, letting him dive.
Strong early duelist with good tankiness.
The Relentless Storm passive gives attack speed and chain lightning.
weaknesses: Short range: he must reach enemies to deal damage.
His stun is on a basic attack and can be avoided with dashes.
Falls off late against kiting and high-damage teams.
Grievous Wounds cuts his healing hard.
No dashes apart from Stormbringer's leap.

curve.lvl1: strong – Q stun and auto attacks give a strong level 1
curve.lvl2: strong – W heals and marks for more trades
curve.lvl3: strong – E slow and shield finish an all-in
curve.lvl6: very strong – Stormbringer dives towers and starts fights
curve.items: medium – first item: Riftmaker or Sunderer Sky for damage; Spirit Visage, Sunfire Aegis for tankiness
curve.late: okay – stays a good diving tank but falls off against kite

profile.curveNote: Volibear is strong from level 1, and stronger at 6 with Stormbringer. His power is early, before items for the enemy team.
profile.waveClear: Good: W and passive chain lightning clear waves.
profile.sustain: High: W heals on a marked target.
profile.mobility: Good: Q speed and R leap.

keyAbilities.trading: Q (Thundering Smash) stun into W (Frenzied Maul)
keyAbilities.answers: None. Volibear has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: The Relentless Storm: stacking attack speed; at max stacks his attacks chain lightning.

Q.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries.
Q.notes: Thundering Smash: move speed toward champions, then his next attack stuns.

W.notes: Frenzied Maul: point-and-click damage that marks the target. Hitting a marked target again heals him.

E.answer: Walk out of the area before it lands.
E.notes: Sky Splitter: a lightning bolt that deals % max HP damage, slows, and shields him if he stands in it.

R.notes: Stormbringer: leaps to a location and disables towers in range. Also slows enemies where he lands.

profile.windowAgainst: Volibear's window is when his Q is on cooldown: kite him, and fight away from towers after 6.
